scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; ua="${npm_config_user_agent:-}"; execp="${npm_execpath:-}"; if [ -n "$ua" ]; then case "$ua" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; else case "$execp" in *pnpm*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; fi'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.railway:build: PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/wick-betts build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build
